news.headline: Watch best moments and top plays live from Week 11
Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith sets Big Ten receiving record
news.description: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith broke yet another record, eclipsing the Big Ten mark for career receiving yards during the first half vs. Northwestern.

news.headline: Tracking Ohio State WR Jeremiah Smith's record-setting 2026 season
news.description: Ohio State's superstar receiver has made breaking records a weekly occurrence this fall.

news.headline: Alabama makes last-second call to start QB Keelon Russell
news.description: No. 3 Alabama made a last-second decision to start Keelon Russell against Vanderbilt after the quarterback looked better than anticipated in pregame warmups.

news.headline: Maryland QB Malik Washington doesn't start vs. Wisconsin
news.description: Maryland quarterback Malik Washington did not start against Wisconsin as he continues to deal with a lower-body injury.

news.headline: Colorado upsets No. 14 Houston for first AP top-15 win since 2007
news.description: Colorado posted its first victory over an AP top-15 team since 2007 in beating No. 14 Houston 42-32 and slightly cooled down the hot seat for coach Deion Sanders.

news.headline: Ole Miss-Oklahoma bumped to Sunday despite Sooners AD's 'strong objection'
news.description: Oklahoma AD Roger Denny was critical of the SEC's decision to move the Sooners' home game against Ole Miss to Sunday following Friday's nationwide ground stop.

news.headline: UCLA QB Ty Dieffenbach says first-half shoulder injury vs. Illinois not serious
news.description: UCLA starting quarterback Ty Dieffenbach exited because of a shoulder injury late in the second quarter but returned to lead the Bruins past Illinois 22-14.

news.headline: Wake Forest claims 'Bachelor U' status after Sam Hartman news
news.description: Wake Forest football is the only program, the school says, to have had three former players feature in "The Bachelor" franchise.

news.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
news.description: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.
